opportunities.title: Research Awards (Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales, and Open Research)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards are not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree, and retrospective applications are not considered.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, across archaeology, art history, architectural and buildings history, material culture, and history of collecting. Includes named awards (Marion Wilson, Joan Pye, Hugh Chapman).

opportunities.title: Beatrice de Cardi Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Two references required. Applications from project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Named research award within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme, historically supporting research in Arabia and the Middle East.

opportunities.title: Janet Arnold Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications from project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Named research award within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme, supporting research into dress and textiles.

opportunities.title: Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler Travel Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications from project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Travel award within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme, supporting archaeological fieldwork and travel.

opportunities.title: William Lambarde Memorial Travel Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications from project director or principal investigator. Intended for applicants who require funds primarily for their own research travel.
opportunities.summary: Travel award within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme for researchers whose funds are primarily for their own research travel.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required. Supporting documents (photographs, architect/conservation reports, budgets) must be uploaded.
opportunities.summary: Church conservation grants supporting the conservation of church buildings and furnishings, with two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August).

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required. Apply via the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants application form.
opportunities.summary: Textile conservation and research grants supporting conservation of textiles. Applications are made through the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants application form.
